question: What effect follows whomever the adept touches or sees?
premises: The adept may touch someone with the hand
The adept may see someone with the eye
Repeated reference emphasizes any such person
inference: Whomever the adept touches or sees is subject to that power.
uncertainties: The specific effect on the person touched or seen is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Whomever he touches with his hand, whomever he sees with his eye—
